segments.title: 第199章 顏竹笙我生氣了
segments.content:
Chapter 199: Yan Zhusheng, I'm Angry

83kanshu, Rekindling the Verdant Years!

A little after three in the afternoon, Li Luo and Xu Youyu went out together to buy groceries.

On the way to the market, he also gave Yan Zhusheng a call, asking her to come over for dinner in the evening.

And so, the cooking auntie once again received a call from Yan Zhusheng. The moment the call connected, the cooking auntie already knew she probably wouldn't have to work that evening.

But at half-past three, while Li Luo and Xu Youyu were still shopping, he received a call from Yan Zhusheng.

"Hello? What's up?"

"I'm here," Yan Zhusheng said from the other end. "Is no one home?"

"...Senior and I are still buying groceries." Li Luo was speechless. "How did you get here so fast? It's not dinnertime yet."

"But I have nothing to do at home either." Yan Zhusheng blinked. "I came right over after you called."

"Then just wait at the door for a little while," Li Luo said. "We're almost done shopping. We'll head back now."

"Zhusheng is here?" Xu Youyu, who was standing beside him, couldn't help but ask after he hung up.

"Yeah." Li Luo nodded. "Let's just buy a fish and then head back."

The two of them bought a fish and immediately rushed home.

About ten minutes later, they saw Yan Zhusheng at the door of apartment 1502.

At that moment, Yan Zhusheng was squatting sideways by the door, holding her phone in her hands, though it was unclear what she was looking at.

Hearing the sound of the elevator door opening, she turned her head and saw Li Luo and Xu Youyu walking out. Yan Zhusheng immediately stood up, jogged over to Li Luo's side, and took the plastic bags from his hands.

With his hands now free, Li Luo took out his keys and opened the door.

"You can watch some TV first," Li Luo said to Yan Zhusheng, then looked at Xu Youyu. "Senior, come help me out."

"Oh." Yan Zhusheng blinked, staring at Li Luo for a moment. Seeing he had nothing more to say, she obediently went to sit on the sofa.

Then she turned her head to look at Li Luo. Seeing he had already walked into the kitchen, she turned back with a little disappointment, picked up the remote, and turned on the TV.

Meanwhile, Xu Youyu followed him into the kitchen, put on an apron, and started helping Li Luo wash vegetables and so on.

She wasn't allowed to chop things.

Li Luo had let Xu Youyu chop vegetables before, but the way she held the knife was truly a bit terrifying. Li Luo was afraid she'd cut her own fingers off, so afterward, he only let her wash the vegetables.

"I can learn, you know," Xu Youyu said, washing vegetables on the side. Once she was done, she'd pass them to Li Luo. Watching him on the cutting board, chop-chop-chopping the vegetables into strips with great skill, her eyes showed a hint of eagerness. "You just have to teach me."

"Teaching you would be a bit of a waste of time."

"Are you saying I'm dumb?"

"No, I mean, as long as one person in the house knows how to cook, that's enough. No need to trouble you, Senior," Li Luo said with a laugh. "Besides, it's usually Xixi who helps. You only come over once in a while."

"I think you're just being stingy," Xu Youyu huffed. "I've seen Xixi's knife skills, they're quite good. Didn't you teach her?"

"My mom taught her," Li Luo said. "She's been eating at my house since she was little and often helped out in the kitchen. She learned over time."

"Is Xixi that capable?" Xu Youyu was a little surprised. "Then why can't I learn over time?"

"You can learn if you want to. First, learn the proper way to hold the knife and vegetables. Otherwise, I'm always worried you'll cut your fingers."

"Then teach me." Xu Youyu moved closer to Li Luo, looking at his hands as he chopped. "Is there any difference in what you're doing?"

"It's mainly the left hand," Li Luo said. "Your fingers have to be arched like this, like a chicken's claw, and then press against the side of the blade."

"See, no matter how I chop like this, it's impossible to cut my fingers. That's why I can chop so quickly."

"Otherwise, if you lay your fingers flat like you do, the moment you speed up a little, you'll cut them."

"Oh." Xu Youyu felt like she'd gotten it. She immediately patted Li Luo's shoulder. "Let me, let me! Isn't this pretty simple? I feel like I've already learned it."

"Then you try. Chop this carrot," Li Luo handed her the knife but still watched from the side very carefully. "Slow down, get used to the posture first."

"Like this?"

"Bend your fingers a bit more. Your fingertips need to be behind your knuckles, so they won't get cut." Li Luo reached out and helped adjust her fingers, correcting her posture.

"Oh, oh." Xu Youyu was getting the hang of it, nodding repeatedly, but the posture felt a little awkward, and chopping felt strange. "Like this? It feels a bit hard to exert force."

"Let's adjust your knife grip too." Li Luo stood behind Xu Youyu, reached out with both hands, and demonstrated for her. "Look, like this, hold it further forward."

"Pinch the end of the blade directly with your index finger and thumb. It's less effort to chop this way."

"Here, you try it."

Xu Youyu could feel Li Luo's chest pressing against her back and felt the temperature in the kitchen rise a little.

Her lips curled into a slight, secret smile. This was the feeling, she thought.

Although readers had been praising her for writing great slice-of-life details for the past few months, she still wanted to keep improving.

Especially when it came to those subtle psychological feelings. Without experiencing them firsthand, it was truly difficult to capture that kind of flavor with words. Fortunately, she had a perfect subject for research right beside her, and she had just seized another opportunity.

"Hey, Li Luo."

"Hm?"

"Can you help me a little more?"

"What do you mean?"

"Just like this." Xu Youyu took the initiative to grab Li Luo's hands, wrapped them around herself, and then placed his hands over hers. "You control my hands. Wouldn't that be a faster way to teach?"

"You... you have quite a few requests."

Originally, Li Luo had been quite mindful, standing behind Xu Youyu while maintaining a certain distance, not completely pressing against her back.

But being pulled like this by Xu Youyu, Li Luo ended up holding her entirely in his arms. Although it was a loose embrace, it at least looked the part.

However, that wasn't the main problem.

The main thing was that the kitchen wasn't cold to begin with. After coming inside, Xu Youyu had taken off her down jacket, wearing just a sweater.

After putting on the apron, the same one that looked perfectly ordinary on Ying Chanxi suddenly seemed to be set against towering peaks.

And at this very moment, Li Luo's position behind her happened to be the prime viewing spot.

This distracted him somewhat. After taking hold of Xu Youyu's hands to steady the knife, his chopping speed slowed considerably.

This made Xu Youyu a little puzzled. As if sensing something, she turned her head to glance at Li Luo, then chuckled softly. "Hey, are you looking at the carrot, or at something else?"

"Ahem... don't turn your head when you're chopping," Li Luo said with a stern, serious face.

After being tormented by Xu Youyu for several minutes, Li Luo finally escaped his senior's clutches.

Even though it was the middle of winter and the stove hadn't even been turned on yet, the kitchen was already unbearably hot.

Fortunately, after helping wash the vegetables and learning how to chop them, Xu Youyu obediently left the kitchen and stopped bothering him, allowing Li Luo to focus completely on cooking.

By five in the evening, four dishes and a soup were successfully prepared. Li Luo carried the dishes to the dining table in the living room and said to the two people on the sofa, "Wash your hands, time to eat."

Xu Youyu was the first to go to the bathroom to wash her hands.

As for Yan Zhusheng, she suddenly stopped as she passed by Li Luo and said to him with a serious expression, "Li Luo, I'm a little cold."

As she spoke, she even adjusted the collar of her clothes, her gaze fixed on the scarf around Li Luo's neck.

But Li Luo didn't understand her meaning and just said, "I'll turn up the heat on the living room air conditioner then."

Seeing him really go to get the remote, Yan Zhusheng fell silent and obediently went to wash her hands.

After dinner, Xu Youyu started clearing the table and went to the kitchen to wash the dishes.

Li Luo, on the other hand, planned to go back to his bedroom to write a bit before heading to school for the evening self-study session.

But Yan Zhusheng followed him into his bedroom, her eyes scanning the room as if searching for something.

"What are you doing?" Li Luo asked strangely. "I'm going to write now. You should wait in the living room for a bit, or go help Senior with the dishes."

Hearing him say that, Yan Zhusheng finally couldn't help but narrow her eyes and stare at Li Luo. "You're so dense."

Li Luo: "...Why are you suddenly scolding me?"

Yan Zhusheng searched a little more but still couldn't find what she was looking for. Finally, she had no choice but to ask Li Luo, "Where's the scarf Auntie gave me? Did you forget to bring it?"

"..." Hearing her ask this, Li Luo was at a loss for words. "You were looking for this?"

With that, Li Luo walked to his bed, opened his schoolbag, and took out an orange-yellow scarf. "Here. I was planning to give it to you at school, so I just stuffed it in my bag."

"Oh." Yan Zhusheng didn't reach out to take it. Instead, she sat down silently on the edge of Li Luo's bed without saying a word.

"What's wrong? Take it," Li Luo asked, puzzled. "What are you sitting here for?"

"I'm angry."

"Ha." Li Luo looked at her expressionless face and found it nothing but adorable.

Seeing that she wouldn't take the scarf, Li Luo laughed and shook his head. He walked over to her and personally wrapped the scarf around her neck. "Is this okay? See if it's comfortable."

"It's comfortable."

"Weren't you angry?"

"I'm not angry anymore."

(End of Chapter)
